messages:
kyle_sec: :rotating_light: Heads up — cert-provisioner in prod fired its deadman switch after a KMS IAM delta during a deploy. We started seeing 403s from the provisioner which caused ~2% failed TLS handshakes. Putting initial details here for triage.

maria_ops: @kyle_sec can you paste the provisioner logs? is this limited to one region or global?

kyle_sec: copying snippets from the provisioner service logs:
```
2026-03-20T18:02:12Z cert-provisioner ERROR failed to unwrap DEK: AccessDenied KMS
2026-03-20T18:02:12Z cert-provisioner WARN deadman_switch engaged: route fallback -> self-signed
```
Only eu-west-1 is affected so far.

ashley_crypto: :eyes: Did any RBAC changes land in the last hour? iam-audit shows a role update to `kms-unwrap` by `infra-bot` at 17:58 UTC.

dev-bot: IncidentAlert: cert-provisioner-deadman-switch triggered (eu-west-1). PagerDuty: on-call escalated.

sophie_sre: rolling back the 17:58 deploy now. ETA ~5m. If rollback doesn't fix it we'll revoke the new role binding.

nate_eng: quick note — can we avoid self-signed fallback while we triage? Downstream clients treat self-signed certs as fatal and cascade.

maria_ops: agree — patching provisioner to keep previously valid certs in cache for 10m instead of immediately falling back to self-signed. Pushing hotfix to canary now.

ashley_crypto: also need an audit correlation: which KMS key ARNs were used and which principal issued UnwrapKey. I'll run a CloudTrail/KMS query and link results.

kyle_sec: created a short runbook in the incident channel: `steps: 1) rollback deploy 2) disable deadman switch 3) patch cache timeout 4) audit KMS unwraps 5) followup postmortem`. Opening incident channel and assigning owners.

sophie_sre: rollback succeeded, error rate back to baseline (0%). Hotfix queued to canary; will promote after 30m stable. :lock: 

maria_ops: filing a compliance ticket to require cert-provisioner to have monthly simulated IAM rotations in CI.

nate_eng: FYI I'll prototype a pre-deploy check in GitHub Actions that asserts `kms:Decrypt`/`kms:UnwrapKey` allowed for `service/cert-provisioner@infra` across all regions before merging.

ashley_crypto: recommended change: require the deadman switch to need 2 conditions (KMS unwrap failures + sustained 5m error window) before switching to self-signed. This reduces noisy fallbacks.

kyle_sec: adding KMS ARNs + CloudTrail snippets to the incident thread, and starting a vuln triage for any potential principal escalation or misuse.

dev-bot: IncidentCreated: INC-2026-0945
